components.css: .ds-range{width:230px;max-width:100%;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-range label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--muted, #a8b8ce);font-size:12px}.ds-range output{font:400 12px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace;color:#dbe5f4;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-range input{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:100%;height:24px;margin:7px 0 0;background:transparent;display:block;cursor:pointer}.ds-range input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cyan, #56d9f5) var(--ds-fill),#34465e var(--ds-fill))}.ds-range input::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#d1f5fc;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0004;margin-top:-4px}.ds-range input::-moz-range-track{height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cyan, #56d9f5) var(--ds-fill),#34465e var(--ds-fill))}.ds-range input::-moz-range-thumb{width:12px;height:12px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#d1f5fc}.ds-range input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan, #56d9f5);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-range input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.html:
Original meets reconstructed

Solid = truth, dashed = receiver

narrative.overview:
Signal Loom uses navy depth, purposeful signal colors, geometric machine drawings, and legible readings to make a live experiment understandable. The approved direction is preserved: a dominant process stage carries the causal story, a comparison plot exposes reconstruction quality, and controls and evidence stay close to the experiment.

The material is matte and restrained. Manrope carries language; IBM Plex Mono makes quantities easy to compare. Animation explains actual decisions and transmissions, while the rotor is explicitly an illustrative load proxy. Outcome numbers have bars, traces, sample strips, or event journeys beside them. Estimates and measurements remain distinguishable through words and geometry as well as color.
keyCharacteristics: A dark laboratory instrument with tonal surfaces and thin structural dividers.
Cyan measurements, violet reconstruction, amber suppression, and coral faults.
Locally bundled type, tabular readings, and geometric SVG process imagery.
Motion tied to experiment state, with equivalent static information.
Responsive density that preserves process, controls, outcomes, and evidence.

rules.name: The Signal Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep cyan measurement, violet reconstruction, amber suppression or correction, and coral event or failure meanings consistent across diagrams, charts, controls, and evidence.

rules.name: The Redundant Encoding Rule
rules.body: Pair signal color with a line style, marker shape, or readable state label. Solid truth, dashed receiver traces, exact-sample circles, correction rings, and event labels remain identifiable without color alone.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono and tabular numerals for quantities and time, with explicit units or a nearby interpretation. Reserve Manrope for the language that explains the reading.

rules.name: The Matte Instrument Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with tone, spacing, type, and thin rules; keep shadows and translucent effects local to the control or process material that needs them.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved navy instrument palette and stable signal meanings.
**Do** pair each prominent experiment reading with its relevant trace, bar, sample strip, or event journey.
**Do** distinguish exact readings, estimates, corrections, and events through labels and geometry.
**Do** use locally bundled Manrope for language and IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals for readings.
**Do** keep focus visible, controls labeled, and static information complete when motion stops.
**Do** preserve the process-to-controls-to-evidence reading order as the layout stacks.
donts: **Don't** introduce decorative glass, excessive glow, constant blinking, or neon-green terminal styling.
**Don't** replace the outcome strip with a wall of identical filled statistic cards.
**Don't** animate fabricated traffic or let illustrative machine movement imply measured network latency.
**Don't** communicate live, stale, estimated, or fault state through color alone.
**Don't** hide missing data or failure behind a successful-looking value or fabricated calibration envelope.
